caption:
Baking by cups is guesswork. A scale is the fix, and this one is $10.99.

A cup of flour can vary by a lot depending on whether you scooped it or spooned it, and that difference is the reason two people follow the same recipe and get two different loaves. Weight doesn't have that problem — 120 grams is 120 grams every time. A kitchen scale is also the quiet solution to portioning coffee, dividing dough, and mailing a package without a trip to the post office.

The Etekcity Food Kitchen Scale is a compact digital scale that weighs what you put on it, so recipes stop being an estimate. With 176,516 reviews averaging 4.6 stars, this isn't a niche gadget — it's a product a very large number of people have used long enough to rate, and the score has held up across all of them.

You get repeatable results from the recipes you already make, without changing anything else about how you cook. It's $10.99.
